results.title: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
results.summary: Argues that uniform RDMA for inter-pool KV cache transfer ignores 72x bandwidth variation across GPU pairs, and proposes a topology-aware orchestrator selecting among NVLink, PCIe, RDMA, and CXL transports, reporting 3-18x transfer latency reduction over uniform RDMA.

results.title: SAC: Disaggregated KV Cache System for Sparse Attention LLMs with CXL
results.summary: Proposes CXL-based cache-line-granularity remote KV cache access as an alternative to RDMA's coarse-grained bulk prefix-cache fetching for sparse attention models, reporting 2.1x throughput and 9.7x lower TTFT over RDMA baselines on DeepSeek-V3.2 with SGLang.

results.title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
results.summary: Shows that hybrid-attention models shrink KVCache enough to transfer it over commodity Ethernet between datacenters, using a two-tier network with RDMA for latency-sensitive PD KVCache transfers and bandwidth-aware scheduling to selectively offload prefill.

results.title: Serving Agentic Workloads at Scale with vLLM x Mooncake
results.summary: Official vLLM post describing a distributed Mooncake Store KV cache pool spanning multiple vLLM instances with GPUDirect RDMA zero-copy KV transfer, reporting 3.8x throughput and 46x lower TTFT on Codex agentic traces across up to 60 GPUs.

results.title: DualPath: Breaking the Storage Bandwidth Bottleneck in Agentic LLM Inference
results.summary: Introduces dual-path KV-Cache loading that adds a storage-to-decode route and then transfers the cache to prefill engines via RDMA over the compute network to balance storage NIC saturation, achieving up to 1.96x online serving throughput.

results.title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
results.summary: The canonical paper (later published at USENIX FAST '25) behind Kimi's serving platform, detailing a Transfer Engine using RDMA queue pairs for zero-copy KV cache movement between prefill and decode nodes and a KVCache-centric disaggregated design.

results.title: Mooncake: KVCache-centric disaggregated LLM serving platform (Transfer Engine, P2P Store, Mooncake Store)
results.summary: Open-source repository for Mooncake whose Transfer Engine, P2P Store, and Mooncake Store implement RDMA-based KV cache and weight transfer; release notes cite SGLang's RDMA-based P2P weight transfer built on the TransferEngine achieving 7x faster updates.
